description.text: Grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tifa], [Final Heaven Damage Tracker] and [Final Heaven Level]

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tifa
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Final Heaven (0~2), removed after using Final Heaven two times

description.name: Final Heaven Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Final Heaven level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tifa]

description.name: Final Heaven Level
description.text: Keeps track of Final Heaven level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tifa]
